title: Policy wire v0.1 — SDK supported structure
description: Aligned with the current registry-api policy wire. additionalProperties:false deliberately closes the SDK-supported envelope, payload, policy entry and manifest skeleton; this is not a general OpenAPI validator or full Core semantic validation.

manifest.description: Wire skeleton only. Full ManifestV2/Cedar semantics remain an engine/Core check.

payload.description: Current API payload fields. Verify the UTF-8 bytes of the original B string without reserialization. Non-null registry_ref and non-default profile are handed to Core semantic validation.

sequence.description: Positive JSON integer in the JS safe-integer range, compared numerically within the configured env/profile scope.

registry_ref.description: v0.1 accepts null; a string must reach the distinct semantic UNSUPPORTED_REGISTRY_REF error.

signature.description: 64-byte IEEE P1363 r||s, canonical padded Base64. ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 is fixed locally, not negotiated by a response alg field. Encoding validity is not signature validity.

payload.description: B: original JSON text. Validate the parsed value separately with $defs.payload; never sign JSON.stringify(parsed).

key_id.description: Optional telemetry; empty or unknown IDs do not select trust or invalidate an otherwise valid signature.
